title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 14 | The Magic Tower | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
The party finds a tall magic tower with a rune-locked door, and inside... Owli the Mage, surrounded by floating books! Owli joins the team, helps calm a grumpy Moss Golem with a Starlight Rain, and shows everyone the constellations from the tower balcony.

0:00 Road to the Tower
0:45 Owli's Floating Library
1:30 The Golem Trial
2:15 Stargazing

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
